title: Audio Asset Lifecycle, Interchange, Rights, Review & Publication

selection_basis.reduced_strict_order: MSAS-01 → MSAS-03 → MSAS-04 → MSAS-05 → MSAS-07 → MSAS-09 → MSAS-12 → MSAS-14 → MSAS-15 → MSAS-18 → MSAS-21
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MRCS-12 remains selected_not_started; MVPS-19 remains selected_not_started.

objective: Implement the audio-asset lifecycle seam for accepted/rejected versions and variants, localization review, structured interchange and round-trip reporting, middleware bridges, rights/consent/provenance/sample/voice identity presentation, generated-candidate review and governed publication while delegating generic identity, rights, version/review and generation infrastructure to ARI/PCA owners.
boundaries: MSAS-01 through MSAS-15 remain prior studio, semantic, voice, spatial and live-control foundations consumed by this tranche.
ARI plus PCA-01/PCA-15 retain generic resource identity, rights/use capability, derivative lineage, provenance, review/locking/dependency and asset-governance authority.

PCA-08 retains reusable voice/speech/SFX production and ARI registration primitives; PCA-09 retains provider-neutral generation orchestration; PCA-13 retains generic localization-production infrastructure.
MSAS-18 owns the audio-domain lifecycle presentation and structured interchange/round-trip seam, not a replacement generic asset-governance system.
Accepted/rejected versions and variants preserve lineage; rejected or superseded material is not silently deleted or overwritten.
Generated music/SFX/voice remains candidate content until explicit acceptance and ARI registration.
Voice identity/cloning and publication require explicit consent/right evidence; absence fails closed.
Structured import/export and middleware round-trip report unsupported, lossy and unknown semantics explicitly and preserve canonical semantic IDs where supported.
Provider/media unavailability remains explicit and nonblocking where AAI says audio is optional; local/provider-off lifecycle remains blocking-capable.
Meaningful spoken/sonic material retains transcript/caption or semantic non-audio alternatives where applicable.
MSAS-21 remains unauthorized until separately selected.
MRCS and MVPS lane state remains independent.
next_action: MSAS-18 is completed_verified. MSAS-21 is selected_not_started as the final reduced MSAS proof tranche. MRCS and MVPS remain independent and were preserved from fresh CURRENT.json.
